'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Joe Orthner DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Orthner]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Scummy
* '''Username:''' Grawaines
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
